没有待核验的刷写任务: No pending flash task to check
当前设备或 CP 槽位已变化，保留任务以人工核验: Device or CP slot changed. Task kept for manual verification.

正在写入当前 CP 槽位，请勿断电: Writing the current CP slot. Do not disconnect power.
等待后台任务结果（不自动重试）: Waiting for background task results (no automatic retry)

写入前检查失败，没有写入分区。检查任务日志后再处理，不自动重试。: Pre-write checks failed. No partition was written. Inspect task logs before proceeding; no automatic retry.
刷写未完成。请保持供电，不要重启；任务与备份已保留，不自动重试。: Flash incomplete. Keep power on and do not reboot. Task and backup kept; no automatic retry.
暂未取得最终结果。后台任务可能仍在运行；请使用“检查未完成任务”，不要重复写入。: Final result is unavailable. The background task may still be running. Use Check unfinished task; do not repeat the write.
